description: This file implements the PersistentStore class, including initialization, deinitialization, and internal management of store components within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It handles configuration, resource management, and external interface registration.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A class managing persistent storage within the WPEFramework plugin, including initialization, cleanup, and resource management.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the persistent store, sets up configuration, and registers interfaces.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, and releases references.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Information
methods.description: Returns a string with information about the persistent store (currently empty).
